newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia Stock Exchange to nominate Korins-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia Stock Exchange to nominate Korins-WSJ.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange is expected to nominate Leopold Korins -- a former head of the Pacific Exchange -- for its chief executive post, the Wall Street Journal said on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The newspaper said in its electronic edition that if accepted, Korins would succeed the exchange's current CEO Nicholas Giordano.
Giordano had to reapply for the job as a result of governance changes, the newspaper said.
It said Korins did not return a telephone call left at his home.
